<|det|>title [105, 327, 307, 356]<|/det|>Description
<|det|>text [134, 369, 907, 433]<|/det|>The Burve contract allows users to provide liquidity to both the Island pool and Uniswap V3 pools. The number of shares minted to users is determined using the following calculation:
<|det|>text [149, 457, 780, 692]<|/det|>function islandLiqToShares(uint128 liq) internal view returns
    (uint256 shares) {
    if (address(island) == address(0x0)) {
    revert NoIsland();
    }

    (uint160 sqrtRatioX96,,,,, ) = pool.slot( );
    (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) = getAmountsFromLiquidity(
    sqrtRatioX96,
    island.lowerTick(),
    island.upperTick(),
    liq
    );
    (,, shares) = island.getMintAmounts(amount0, amount1);
}
<|det|>text [134, 720, 930, 784]<|/det|>Since the amount of shares depends on sqrtRatioX96, any fluctuations in this value will impact the number of shares users receive. As a result, users may end up with fewer tokens than expected.
<|det|>title [106, 805, 423, 831]<|/det|>Recommendations
<|det|>text [135, 848, 861, 869]<|/det|>Consider adding a minSharesOut parameter to the mint/burn functions.
<|det|>page_number [486, 963, 514, 980]<|/det|>18
